skill.summary: Gowok: Golang Premwok. The Golang library that helps you to build your own project starter (or framework, possibly).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added comprehensive SKILL.md with project description, background, use cases, and core features.
- Detailed available utilities: config loader, bootstrapper, HTTP response builder, nil safety, password hash, and more.
- Explained primary use cases: REST API backend, GRPC microservice, and event-driven workers.
- Outlined developer experience and ease of starting a project with Gowok.
- Listed core and advanced features in organized tables with reference links.
